title: Repo-pinned delegation can execute an out-of-workspace binary
description: Evidence: repo-binary-pin.ts accepts bwrkPin.binPath from .boreal/project.json as any string, resolves absolute paths, and delegation.ts spawnSyncs that path before normal command handling. Impact: running machine bwrk in an untrusted repo can execute a repo-chosen binary outside the workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: Project-config bwrk pins are rejected unless their real path is inside the selected workspace and matches an expected repo-binary shape.
A regression fixture with bwrkPin.binPath pointing outside the workspace fails before spawn and reports a recovery action.
